basis: Each invariant traced to the pinned Forge source (exact file/method/line) AND, where marked RUNTIME, freshly executed on locally compiled pin classes. CODE_DERIVED rows cite the source path; RUNTIME rows cite the witness artifact + variant.
disposition_use: Rows 1-6 (all NOT_PRESERVED) jointly establish that restore frozen at a decision-bearing step cannot serve as a trustworthy continuation substrate. Row 7 (PRESERVED) bounds the salvage: injected topology binds the same native objects the engine would consume IF the pipeline ran (witness F).
